place.zh: 沉鼎观 · 大比 · 第二轮 · 对卢方
place.en: Chending Temple · The contest · Round two · Against Lu Fang

setup.zh: 第二轮，对面是卢方：内门六层，金刃、土墙。他看了一眼石阶上的孙二狗，道：「外门的，一个比一个不知道天高地厚。」这一回，他没背手。
setup.en: Round two, and across from you is Lu Fang: layer six of the inner court, metal blade and earth wall. He glances at Sun Ergou on the steps: "Outer court — each one knows less of heaven and earth than the last." This time he doesn't put his hands behind his back.

recap.zh: 第二轮你对卢方：他的金刃、土墙，你火打给他看，木吃土；第三掌打裂了你的肋骨，你扒在台沿上，他踩着你的手碾——你看他的脚，等风，一把拽住他撑地的脚踝，把内门的六层从你头顶上翻下了台。
recap.en: In round two you fought Lu Fang: against his metal blade and earth wall you threw fire for show and wood to eat the earth; his third palm cracked your rib, you hung from the rim and he ground your hand underfoot — you watched his feet, waited for the wind, seized the ankle he stood on, and flipped the inner court's layer six over your head and off the stage.

zh: 第二轮。对面，卢方，内门六层。
en: Round two. Across from you, Lu Fang, layer six of the inner court.
A metal blade, an earth wall.
Watch the wind first, then the deer.

story.zh:
那一上午，五行台上打了三轮。内门排头的祁长松，九层——秘境里他还是八层，八层吃不得筑基丹，他便守着那道坎；出来一个月，他破了九层。秘境十年一开，下一回，他等不起。这一颗丹，是他在内门站了二十年，头一回够得着的。内门里管他叫「祁不动」。他上台，往台心那道拼缝上一站，两只脚像钉进了石头，对手打他，打不动，推他，推不动，打到后来，自己喘得直不起腰，认了输。小满在台下看了他两场，看的不是他的脸，是他的脚：两场下来，那两只脚没挪过一寸；那两只手，也没出过一拳。

第二轮，小满对卢方。

卢方上台的时候，眼皮还是耷拉着，看了一眼小满，又看了一眼台下坐在石阶上的孙二狗，道：「外门的，一个比一个不知道天高地厚。」他没背手。这一回，他先出手了。

他右手一扬，一道白光从掌心里削出来，是金刃，贴着青石板削向小满的脚踝。小满往旁一跳，金刃削在台沿上，削下来一角石头。卢方吸了一口气——阿禾那张纸上写着的，一个字不差：使完金刃，要喘一口气——左手才往下一按，小满身前「轰」地拱起一堵土墙，齐胸高，把他往台边上挤。那一口气的工夫，小满两只手里早都攥好了。他右手一颗火弹打在土墙上，土墙只黑了一块；左手跟着一抖，一根木藤从土墙根底下钻了出去，土墙「咔」地裂了一道缝——火是打给卢方看的，木才是吃土的。台下有人「咦」了一声：「卢师兄换一样，还得喘一口气；他……他一口气扔了两样？」卢方的眼皮，头一回抬了起来。
story.en:
That morning three rounds were fought on the platform. Qi Changsong, first on the inner register, was layer nine — in the hidden realm he had still been eight, and at eight one can't take a Foundation pill, so he had stood guard at that threshold; a month after coming out he broke through to nine. The hidden realm opens once in ten years; the next time, he couldn't wait. This pill was the first he had ever been within reach of, in twenty years standing in the inner court. In the inner court they called him Immovable Qi. He went up, planted himself on the seam at the centre, feet as if nailed into the stone; opponents hit him and he didn't budge, pushed him and he didn't budge, until they were too winded to stand straight and yielded. Xiaoman watched two of his bouts from below, and watched not his face but his feet: in two bouts those feet never moved an inch; and those hands never threw a single blow.

Second round: Xiaoman against Lu Fang.

Lu Fang climbed up with his eyelids still drooping, glanced at Xiaoman, then at Sun Ergou sitting on the steps below. "Outer court — each one knows less of heaven and earth than the last." He didn't put his hands behind his back. This time he struck first.

His right hand flicked, and a white light sheared out of his palm — a metal blade, skimming the bluestone at Xiaoman's ankles. Xiaoman jumped aside; the blade sheared the stage's rim and took off a corner of stone. Lu Fang drew a breath — just as A He's page had it, word for word: after a metal blade, he needs a breath — and only then did his left hand press down, and before Xiaoman an earth wall heaved up with a boom, chest-high, crowding him toward the edge. In the space of that breath Xiaoman already had both hands ready. His right threw a fire bolt at the wall, which only blackened a patch; his left followed with a flick, and a wood vine burrowed out from the foot of the wall, and the wall cracked — the fire was for Lu Fang to watch; the wood was what eats earth. Someone below said "Eh?" — "Brother Lu needs a breath to switch — he… he threw two kinds in one breath?" For the first time Lu Fang's eyelids lifted.

label.en: Watch his feet; wait for the wind

exits.means: fights Lu Fang of the inner court; hanging from the rim, seizes his ankle and flips him off the stage

withdrawn.zh: 卢方抖了抖袖子，眼皮又耷拉了下来：「外门的。」——再来。
withdrawn.en: Lu Fang shakes out his sleeves, eyelids drooping again: "Outer court." — Again.

story.zh:
他从那道缝里一掌穿了过来。六层的掌，比何七的拳快了一倍不止。小满看脚，看得见他往哪里去，身子却跟不上：头一掌擦着他的肩膀过去，第二掌他躲开了，第三掌正打在他左肋上，「咔」的一声，秘境里断过的那根骨头，又裂了。他整个人横着飞出去，滚了三滚，滚到了台边，半个身子已经挂在了外头，两只手扒着青石板的边沿，十个指头死死地抠着，底下是演武场的冻土。台下一片惊叫，跟着便有人笑：「完了完了，下去吧！」

卢方走过来，低头看着他扒在石沿上的那两只手，抬起右脚，一脚踩在他左手背上，碾了一碾。跟方才踩孙二狗，一模一样。

那一碾，碾得小满眼前一黑。疼还在其次；他扒在那里，看着那只踩在自己手背上的脚，心里生出来的，是怕。不是怕疼，是怕自己下去。他一下去，孙二狗那七回，就是白倒的。

他咬着牙，不去看那只踩着他的脚，去看另一只。他爹在黑松岭的山涧边上讲过：天下的鹿，都是先动脚。卢方的重心全压在左脚跟上，右脚踩着他，要碾第二下，便得把脚抬一抬——抬的那一霎，他整个人只剩一只脚跟着地。风从北边山口灌过来，扑在卢方背上，吹得他袍子往前一鼓。先看风，后看鹿。

卢方的右脚抬起来了。

小满那只给踩烂的左手不往回缩，反往上一探，五个指头不听使唤，是拿手腕扣住的，扣住了卢方那只撑地的左脚脚踝；右手还扒着石沿，借着身子往下一坠的那一股劲，连着背后那一阵风，往外一拽。卢方那一碾踩了个空，身子往前一扑，整个人从小满头顶上翻了过去，「砰」的一声，脸朝下摔在台下的冻土上。

小满一只手挂在石沿上，晃了两晃，自己爬了上来，跪在台边，喘。

演武场上静了。静了足有一口气的工夫，才有一个声音道：「……外门的？」又一个声音：「四层？把内门的六层……扔下去了？」人堆里「轰」的一声，炸了。石阶上，孙二狗一下子站了起来，忘了自己那只手，拿那只缠着布的肿手往天上一举，扯着嗓子喊：「沈师兄——！」喊破了音。

执事张了两回嘴，才道：「……沈小满，胜。」

台下，卢方趴在冻土上，半天没有起来。他撑起半个身子，低头看着自己那只左脚——熬了九年才熬进内门的那只脚——看了一会儿，一拳砸在冻土上。小满跪在台边看着他。他以为自己会痛快的。那一把拽出去的时候，是痛快的；这时候，他只觉得肋下一阵一阵地抽，左手背上一个青紫的鞋印，心里空了一块，像一口缸，水倒干净了，只剩一个缸底。他爬起来，走下了台，没有回头。
story.en:
He drove a palm through the crack. A layer-six palm was more than twice as fast as He Qi's fist. Xiaoman watched the feet and could see where it was going, but his body couldn't keep up: the first palm grazed his shoulder, the second he dodged, the third landed square on his left ribs — crack — and the bone broken in the hidden realm split again. He flew sideways, rolled three times, rolled to the edge, half his body already hanging over, both hands clawing the rim of the bluestone, ten fingers dug in, the frozen earth of the training ground below. Screams below, and then laughter: "That's it, that's it, get down!"

Lu Fang walked over, looked down at the two hands clinging to the stone rim, lifted his right foot, and stamped on the back of Xiaoman's left hand, and ground it. Exactly as he had stamped on Sun Ergou.

That grinding turned Xiaoman's sight black. The pain was the least of it; clinging there, looking at the foot on his hand, what rose in him was fear. Not of pain; of going down. If he went down, Sun Ergou's seven falls were for nothing.

He gritted his teeth and didn't look at the foot on his hand; he looked at the other one. By the stream at Black Pine Ridge his father had told him: every deer under heaven moves its feet first. All Lu Fang's weight was on his left heel; to grind a second time, his right foot had to lift — and in that lift, the whole man stood on one heel. Wind poured in from the northern pass and struck Lu Fang's back, puffing his robe forward. Watch the wind first, then the deer.

Lu Fang's right foot lifted.

Xiaoman's crushed left hand didn't shrink back; it shot upward — the fingers wouldn't obey, so he hooked with the wrist — and caught the ankle of the left foot Lu Fang stood on; his right still clung to the rim, and with the pull of his body dropping, and the wind at the man's back, he wrenched outward. Lu Fang's grind met nothing; he pitched forward, went clean over Xiaoman's head, and hit the frozen earth below face-first — thud.

Xiaoman hung by one hand from the rim, swung twice, climbed back up by himself, and knelt at the edge, panting.

The training ground went silent. A full breath of silence before one voice said: "…Outer court?" And another: "Layer four? Threw an inner layer six… off the stage?" The crowd exploded. On the steps Sun Ergou shot to his feet, forgot his hand, flung the swollen bandaged thing up at the sky, and bawled: "Brother Shen —!" — his voice cracking.

The steward opened his mouth twice before he said: "…Shen Xiaoman wins."

Below, Lu Fang lay on the frozen earth a long while without rising. He pushed up on one arm and looked at his own left foot — the foot that had taken nine years to grind its way into the inner court — looked a while, then drove a fist into the frozen ground. Xiaoman knelt at the edge and watched him. He had thought it would feel good. In the moment of the wrench, it had; now there was only the pulling in his ribs, a purple footprint on the back of his left hand, and a hollow in his chest, like a vat with the water poured out and only the bottom left. He got up and walked down off the stage and didn't look back.
